headline.purpose: Empty and introductory workspace states only.

label.purpose: Controls, status, fields, counts, and timeline metadata.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: Separate a context menu crossing dark and light surfaces.

shadows.name: overlay-beacon
shadows.purpose: Float and state-tint the active execution beacon.

motion.name: ease-expressive
motion.purpose: Short spatial changes, drawers, and view arrivals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forward action for Run, Save, Record, and equivalent commitments.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:40px; padding:0 13px; border:1px solid var(--ink,#1f1f1d); border-radius:8px; background:var(--ink,#1f1f1d); color:#fff; font:560 11px/1.45 "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease,transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#393936; box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(31,31,29,.18); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#3974d8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.965); transition-duration:70ms; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action that remains secondary to Run or Save.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:40px; padding:0 13px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#d4d4cf); border-radius:8px; background:var(--paper,#fff); color:var(--ink,#1f1f1d); font:560 11px/1.45 "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease,transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface,#f5f5f3); border-color:#b6b6b0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#3974d8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:scale(.965); }

components.name: Native Input
components.description: Compact white-paper field for settings and operator input.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--muted,#6f6f6b); font:550 11px/1.45 "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:42px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#d4d4cf); border-radius:8px; outline:0; background:var(--paper,#fff); color:var(--ink,#1f1f1d); font-size:14px; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#b6b6b0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--focus,#3974d8); outline:2px solid var(--focus,#3974d8); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: Primary intent-entry surface with review mode and send action.
components.html: Review before run
components.css: .ds-composer { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#d4d4cf); border-radius:13px; background:var(--paper,#fff); box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(30,30,28,.035); transition:border-color 180ms ease,box-shadow 260ms ease,transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:#a9a9a3; box-shadow:0 7px 24px rgba(30,30,28,.08),0 1px 4px rgba(30,30,28,.05); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-composer textarea { display:block; width:100%; min-height:58px; padding:14px 15px 8px; resize:none; border:0; outline:0; color:var(--ink,#1f1f1d); font:14px/1.45 "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-composer>div { display:flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 7px 7px 13px; color:var(--muted,#6f6f6b); font-size:11px; } .ds-composer i { display:inline-block; width:6px; height:6px; margin-right:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--success,#2f7a49); } .ds-composer button { width:34px; height:34px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:var(--ink,#1f1f1d); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#3974d8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Conversation Row
components.description: Dark compact chat selector with a separate semantic status line.
components.css: .ds-chat-row { display:grid; width:230px; gap:1px; min-height:42px; padding:5px 8px; border:1px solid #2b2b29; border-radius:8px; background:var(--sidebar,#191918); color:#d9d9d4; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-chat-row:hover { border-color:#41413d; background:var(--sidebar-hover,#292927); } .ds-chat-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#3974d8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-chat-row strong { overflow:hidden; font:520 12px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-chat-row span { color:#979790; font-size:10px; } .ds-chat-row i { display:inline-block; width:6px; height:6px; margin-right:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--success,#2f7a49); }

components.name: Execution Summary
components.description: Compact state header for the right-side execution ledger.
components.css: .ds-execution-summary { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:34px 1fr auto; gap:10px; align-items:start; padding:18px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e5e5e1); background:#f8f8f6; color:var(--ink,#1f1f1d); font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif; overflow:hidden; } .ds-execution-summary>span { display:grid; width:32px; height:32px; place-items:center; border-radius:9px; background:var(--success-soft,#eaf4ed); color:var(--success,#2f7a49); } .ds-execution-summary strong { display:block; margin-top:1px; font-size:13px; } .ds-execution-summary p { margin:2px 0 0; color:var(--muted,#6f6f6b); font-size:11px; } .ds-execution-summary time { color:var(--faint,#989892); font-size:10px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-execution-summary:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#3974d8); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Verified Activity Row
components.description: One evidence-backed action in the execution ledger.
components.css: .ds-activity-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:25px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap:8px; padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e5e5e1); color:var(--ink,#1f1f1d); font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-activity-row>span { display:grid; width:22px; height:22px; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; background:var(--success-soft,#eaf4ed); color:var(--success,#2f7a49); font-size:12px; } .ds-activity-row strong { display:block; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; } .ds-activity-row p { margin:2px 0 0; color:var(--muted,#6f6f6b); font-size:10px; } .ds-activity-row small { color:var(--faint,#989892); font-size:9px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-activity-row:hover { background:var(--surface,#f5f5f3); }

components.name: Execution Beacon
components.description: Top-center active-run capsule from the always-on-top overlay.
components.css: .ds-beacon { display:grid; width:min(420px,100%); min-height:40px; grid-template-columns:18px minmax(0,1fr) auto 28px; gap:7px; align-items:center; padding:4px 7px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#27a77a 34%,rgba(32,32,30,.14)); border-radius:11px; background:rgba(252,252,250,.97); box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(25,25,23,.16),0 2px 8px rgba(39,167,122,.34); color:#20201e; font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-beacon>span { display:grid; width:16px; height:16px; place-items:center; border-radius:5px; background:#e8f2eb; } .ds-beacon i { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#27a77a; box-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(39,167,122,.34); } .ds-beacon strong { overflow:hidden; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:590; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-beacon time { color:#73736e; font-size:11px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-beacon button { width:28px; height:28px; border:0; border-radius:7px; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-beacon button:hover { background:#f3f3f0; } .ds-beacon button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #3974d8; outline-offset:1px; }

narrative.overview:
OmniVLA is a restrained Windows-native control surface for supervised computer use. Its atmosphere is calm, technical, and materially quiet: a dark compact conversation rail anchors the left edge, a warm paper workspace carries the operator's intent and reviewable plan, and a pale execution ledger keeps live actions and evidence visible on the right. The interface presents plans, actions, evidence, intervention, and recovery without exposing provider or model plumbing.

The core story is spatial and immediate: choose a chat, review the proposed plan, run it, watch verified actions accumulate, then complete or recover. The first viewport prioritizes the current chat, a usable plan, and execution status; it does not spend space on marketing language. Color appears as semantic state, while broad multicolor edge light belongs only to the separate execution overlay while work is active.
keyCharacteristics: Dark compact conversation rail, warm central paper, and a right execution ledger.
Dense native controls, hairline separators, and mostly flat surfaces.
Reviewable plan and execution evidence remain visually adjacent on desktop.
Semantic blue, green, amber, and red are state signals rather than decoration.
Motion explains state change through opacity, short transforms, and view transitions.

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color communicates focus, progress, success, attention, or danger; it does not decorate idle workbench surfaces.

rules.name: The Active-Edge Rule
rules.body: Broad ambient colored edge glow appears only in the execution overlay while work is running. The primary workbench stays quiet.

rules.name: The Native Density Rule
rules.body: Use the native body and label scale for operational screens; large type is exceptional and never substitutes for information hierarchy.

rules.name: The First-Viewport Rule
rules.body: The current chat, reviewable plan, and execution status must be available without passing through a welcome or marketing screen.

rules.name: The Adjacent-Evidence Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, keep plan, current evidence, and action history adjacent; on narrow screens, preserve the same hierarchy in a dedicated execution sheet.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces use tone and hairlines; elevation appears only when a layer floats, receives focus, or temporarily crosses the workbench.

rules.name: The Compact-Corner Rule
rules.body: Default to the 8px control radius. Use larger corners only for clearly larger grouped surfaces such as the composer or a message bubble.

dos: Do keep the operator's request, proposed plan, and verified action history legible as one continuous workflow.
Do use warm neutral surfaces and hairlines for structure before reaching for shadow or color.
Do reserve semantic color for focus and execution state.
Do provide a visible keyboard focus indicator and a reduced-motion equivalent.
Do describe progress with phases, action counts, evidence, and completion state.
donts: Don't expose model, provider, token, or chain-of-thought plumbing in the primary workbench.
Don't use marketing headlines, taglines, hero panels, or decorative welcome content in the first viewport.
Don't show ambient edge glow while the system is idle.
Don't invent completion percentages or use color as the sole carrier of execution state.
Don't add hard offset shadows, oversized pills, novelty geometry, or display typography to operational surfaces.
